message: 宵闇に紛れて

name: Macaron
message: 「Feels like it's been a while since we last went on patrol!」

name: Synn
message: 「I actually do it in secret all the time, though.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「That aside, why is your little sister accompanying us?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Because I have the day off from my part-time job.」

name: Ria
message: 「And the real reason?」

name: Macaron
message: 「It's boring being all alone at home!」

name: Ria
message: 「You just wanted to be with Synn, didn't you.」

name: Macaron
message: 「N-No, I didn't! I just thought my big brother would get lonely, so I had no choice but to tag along!」

name: Synn
message: 「You're so kind, Macaron.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, the more the merrier when you're heading out, right?」

name: Misa
message: 「Geez, we aren't doing this for fun, you know!」

name: Sally
message: 「Come on, it's fine. Let's have a lively time eating snacks and stuff♪」

name: Misa
message: 「That wouldn't be a patrol at all!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Don't worry about a thing!」

name: Macaron
message: 「If any Demons try to cause trouble, I'll give them a good, stern talking-to!」

name: Synn
message: 「So we get to hear one of Macaron's precious lectures, huh.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, isn't that reassuring.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Though it isn't as if Mr. Demon is always prowling around.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Still, the academy at night... definitely feels like Demons would be lurking around.」

name: Ria
message: 「Can you sense that sort of thing?」

name: Macaron
message: 「It just feels different from other places, I guess... or maybe it's just the vibe?」

name: Sally
message: 「I know, right~ I've always thought so too~」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Then please tell us sooner~」

name: Misa
message: 「I wonder if it's a sensation only demons can understand...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Is there something special going on with this academy?」

name: Ria
message: 「If I had to say, probably Finis Tower.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Finis Tower?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Look, that huge tower you can see over there.」

name: Misa
message: 「What on earth was it built for...?」

name: Ria
message: 「My big sister or Melilot might know something, though...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Does that mean the tower has turned the academy grounds into something like a haunted spot?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmm, I feel like there's more to it than just that...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihihi, I don't really get it!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Why don't you ask Helena about it later?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah. Well then, shall we do our usual patrol?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nobody's here, huh.」

name: Synn
message: 「Troublemaking demons, signs of Re-Crea, suspicious figures pulling their strings...」

name: Synn
message: 「They really aren't easy to find, are they.」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, it's not something that goes so smoothly.」

name: Ria
message: 「Slow and steady without rushing, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「Right~」

name: Macaron
message: 「So, what exactly is this Re-Crea thing?」

name: Ria
message: 「A phenomenon where a massive force destabilizes the world's existence, eventually leading it to collapse...」

name: Ria
message: 「At least, that's how I heard it from my big sister and Melilot.」

name: Synn
message: 「Does that mean the world we live in, and other worlds too, will disappear?」

name: Macaron
message: 「No way, that's not allowed! Then I won't be able to become the Demon Lord!」

name: Synn
message: 「Even I haven't had nearly enough of my sparkling school life yet.」

name: Ria
message: 「Even so, up until now, it's something we've always managed to avoid, you know.」

name: Synn
message: 「And the one who accomplished that was the Demon Lord, huh...」
In other words, Dad actually managed to pull off a huge feat like saving the world, all things considered.
They say you can't judge a book by its cover, though... well, I guess I'm not really one to talk either.

name: Macaron
message: 「I see... I had no idea the Demon Lord had a job like that...」

name: Macaron
message: 「But since it's to bring peace to the world, maybe that's part of it too...?」

name: Ria
message: 「Macaron-chan, um...」

name: Ria
message: 「Are you really the Demon Lord?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Mmph! Big Sis, are you doubting me!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Ah, um, that's not what I meant...?」

name: Synn
message: 「If it's Macaron, I'm sure she's the real deal. I just have a feeling.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmph, you get it, Big Bro.」
That's also my own wish, hoping that it's true.
Because then Macaron can fulfill her dream, and I can live in peace without ruining my relationships with anyone.

name: Ria
message: 「Of course, I'm counting on you, Macaron-chan, okay?」

name: Macaron
message: 「O-b-v-i-o-u-s-l-y.」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahaha...」

name: Ria
message: 「It feels... a little different from my ideal, but it can't be helped, right...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「So, what do I actually need to do specifically?」

name: Synn
message: 「Re-Crea is something like a massive energy, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「How are we supposed to deal with something so vague...」

name: Ria
message: 「From what I've heard from my older sisters, it seems Re-Crea can sometimes dwell inside the body of a human or a Demon.」

name: Ria
message: 「And then, it turns that host into an agent and wields its power, or something like that...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Then I just gotta beat up this agent guy, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「That person might be the mastermind pulling the strings behind this Re-Crea.」

name: Ria
message: 「That's definitely a possibility.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hmm. I think I've pretty much got the gist of it!」

name: Macaron
message: 「Anyway, just leave it to me and there'll be no problem at all!」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「What are you all making such a commotion about.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Hm?」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「What exactly are you doing at this hour?」

name: Synn
message: 「Sengen'in-sensei...」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「You're from the Student Council.... And it looks like there's an outsider mixed in with you too.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「I don't know what you're up to, but it's well past the time students are supposed to go home.」

name: Synn
message: 「S-Sorry about that...」

name: Synn
message: 「We're, um, in the middle of Student Council activities...」

name: Ria
message: 「We're doing volunteer patrols around the academy.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「No such application has been submitted, as far as I'm aware.」

name: Synn
message: 「We'll be more careful from now on...」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「If the Student Council president acts like this, it sets a poor example for the rest of the students.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「Allowing an outsider on campus without a valid reason is also technically against school rules.」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「You'd do well to keep your little game of playing hero in moderation.」

name: Synn
message: 「Yes, ma'am...」

name: Sengen'in
message: 「I'll let you off the hook for today, so hurry on home.」

name: Ria
message: 「We got scolded...」

name: Macaron
message: 「What's up with that guy... Totally gave off a bad vibe.」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, it can't be helped. Night-duty patrols are part of a teacher's job, after all.」

name: Ria
message: 「We were the ones in the wrong, too.」

name: Synn
message: 「Shall we head back and meet up with everyone over there soon?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. Let's call it a day for tonight.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Geez, we were doing a good thing, so why'd we get yelled at!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sometimes things just go like that.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I guess solitary hardship just comes with the territory of being a hero.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You think so...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, unlike you, big bro, I'm super popular, so I don't have to worry about that.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, is that right.」

name: Ria
message: 「Giggle... You two really get along well.」

name: Macaron
message: 「D-Does it look like that...?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah.」

name: Macaron
message: 「I see, I see...」

name: Macaron
message: 「Well, we're the Demon Lord and her number-one henchman, after all. That's only natural.」

name: Synn
message: 「Since when am I a henchman...?」

name: Macaron
message: 「Nihihi, since forever~」

name: Synn
message: 「Right, whatever you say...」
At this point, maybe I should just take it as Macaron acknowledging me and leave it at that.

name: Macaron
message: 「That guy from earlier... gave me a really nasty feeling...」

name: Macaron
message: 「It bothers me, but I don't want to tell big bro and the others and give them more to worry about...」

name: Macaron
message: 「I really have to become a proper Demon Lord as soon as possible.」

name: Macaron
message: 「Because I'm gonna solve every single bit of it for you!」
